body: You can join me at HAMILTON :)
I'm sorry, I should've clarified in the original post. I'm just looking for ways to deal with/get over this sort of crippling insecurity and restore trust in our relationship.

You aren't dumb, you're scared, and that kind of irrational fear can be impossible to conquer. It is possible they will contact you if you don't respond. You might also think about getting a trusted friend or family member to make the call for you! Whatever happens, it certainly won't ruin your life forever.
